title: Are There Any Places to Eat Nearby?
synopsis:
Amy wants to explore local delicacies. Let’s see how she asks the front desk about nearby restaurants and recommended dishes!
In this lesson, we will focus on learning how to ask about restaurants near the hotel, how to inquire and understand walking directions and distances, and how to request assistance from the front desk.

fullText.simplified:
这儿附近有什么吃的吗？

爱米：您好！请问，这儿附近有什么吃的吗？
前台：这儿附近有很多饭店，中国菜、美国菜、日本菜都有，您喜欢吃什么？
爱米：我想吃中国菜。
前台：您出酒店，往右一直走，在第一个十字路口，往左拐。在路的右边有个中国菜的饭店，叫“天天饭店”。那儿的饭菜又便宜又好吃。
爱米：好的，谢谢！那个饭店离这儿远吗？
前台：不远。走路十分钟就能到。
爱米：请问您有什么推荐的菜吗？
前台：在北京，一定要吃“北京烤鸭”。还有，天天饭店的饺子也很好吃，你可以试试。
爱米：好的，谢谢！啊，外面下雨了，请问您有伞吗？
前台：有，在那儿。您也可以打电话给天天饭店订外卖，请他们送到酒店来，这样您就不用出去了。
爱米：真的吗？那太好了！
fullText.traditional:
這兒附近有什麼吃的嗎？

愛米：您好！請問，這兒附近有什麼吃的嗎？
前臺：這兒附近有很多飯店，中國菜、美國菜、日本菜都有，您喜歡吃什麼？
愛米：我想吃中國菜。
前臺：您出酒店，往右一直走，在第一個十字路口，往左拐。在路的右邊有個中國菜的飯店，叫“天天飯店”。那兒的飯菜又便宜又好吃。
愛米：好的，謝謝！那個飯店離這兒遠嗎？
前臺：不遠。走路十分鐘就能到。
愛米：請問您有什麼推薦的菜嗎？
前臺：在北京，一定要吃“北京烤鴨”。還有，天天飯店的餃子也很好吃，你可以試試。
愛米：好的，謝謝！啊，外面下雨了，請問您有傘嗎？
前臺：有，在那兒。您也可以打電話給天天飯店訂外賣，請他們送到酒店來，這樣您就不用出去了。
愛米：真的嗎？那太好了！

sentence_translations: Are There Any Places to Eat Nearby?
Amy: Hello! Excuse me, are there any places to eat nearby?
Front desk: There are many restaurants nearby. There is Chinese, American, and Japanese food. What do you like to eat?
Amy: I want to eat Chinese food.
Front desk: Exit the hotel and keep walking to the right. At the first intersection, turn left.
On the right-hand side of the road, there is a Chinese restaurant called “Tian Tian Restaurant”.
The food there is both cheap and tasty.
Amy: Great, thanks! Is that restaurant far from here?
Front desk: No, it’s not far.  It’s not far. It’s just a 10-minute walk.
Amy: Do you have any dishes to recommend?
Front desk: In Beijing, you must eat “Peking duck”.
Also, the dumplings at Tian Tian Restaurant are very delicious. You can give them a try.
Amy: Alright, thank you! Oh, it’s raining outside. Do you have an umbrella?
Front desk: Yes, it’s over there. You can also call Tian Tian Restaurant to order takeout and have them deliver it to the hotel.
That way you don’t have to go out.
Amy: Really? That would be great!
